title: Beauty and the Beast
author: Gabrielle-Suzanne de Villeneuve
description: 《美女与野兽》是法国作家加布里埃尔-苏珊·德·维伦纽夫于 1740 年出版的经典童话。故事讲述了一位破产商人因在神秘城堡中采摘了一朵玫瑰，被可怕的野兽扣留。善良孝顺的小女儿贝儿自愿代替父亲前往城堡受罚。在华丽的城堡中，贝儿发现野兽虽然外表凶恶粗鲁，却拥有一颗极其温柔体贴的心。通过长期的相处，贝儿克服了对丑陋外表的偏见，被野兽真挚的爱所打动，最终以纯真的爱解除了邪恶的诅咒，使野兽还原为英俊的王子。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Merchant and His Daughters
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：商人与他的女儿们

paragraphs.en: There was once a very rich merchant, who lived in a grand mansion in the city with his six children, three sons and three daughters. Being a man of sense and broad vision, he spared no expense for their education, providing them with all kinds of excellent tutors in music, literature, and languages. His three daughters were extremely handsome, but the youngest was admired above all. When she was little, everyone praised her sweet temper and called her 'The Little Beauty'; as she grew into a lovely young woman, the name 'Beauty' stuck with her, which excited bitter jealousy in her elder sisters.
paragraphs.zh: 曾经有一位非常富有的商人，他和他的六个孩子（三个儿子和三个女儿）住在城里的一栋豪宅里。作为一位明智且有远见的人，他在教育上不惜重金，为他们请了音乐、文学和语言等各种优秀的家庭教师。他的三个女儿都极其漂亮，但最小的那个最受人赞赏。当她还是个小女孩时，每个人都赞扬她温和的脾气，叫她“小美女”；随着她长成一位可爱的年轻女子，“贝儿”这个名字就一直伴随着她，这在她的姐姐们心中激起了强烈的嫉妒。

paragraphs.en: The two eldest sisters were filled with pride and vanity because of their immense wealth. They gave themselves ridiculous airs, refused to visit other merchants' daughters, and would socialize only with nobility and titled persons. They spent their days attending lavish balls, grand parties, and the opera, constantly ridiculing their youngest sister because Beauty preferred to spend her quiet hours at home reading classic books or practicing her harpsichord.
paragraphs.zh: 两个大姐姐因为巨大的财富而充满了骄傲与虚荣。她们摆出可笑的架子，拒绝拜访其他商人的女儿，并且只与贵族和有封号的人交往。她们把日子花在参加奢华的舞会、盛大的聚会和歌剧上，并不断嘲笑她们最小的妹妹，因为贝儿更喜欢在家里安静地度过时光，阅读经典书籍或练习大键琴。

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Lost Fortune and the Country Cottage
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：破产危机与乡村农舍

paragraphs.en: Because it was widely known that the daughters possessed great fortunes, many eminent and wealthy merchants sought their hands in marriage. However, the two eldest haughtily rejected every proposal, declaring that they would never marry unless they met a duke or at least an earl. Beauty, on the other hand, civilly thanked all her suitors and gently explained that she was still too young to marry, choosing instead to remain with her beloved father.
paragraphs.zh: 因为大家都知道女儿们拥有巨额财富，许多杰出且富有的商人向她们求婚。然而，两个大姐姐高傲地拒绝了所有的求婚，断言除非遇到公爵或者至少是伯爵，否则她们绝不结婚。另一方面，贝儿礼貌地感谢了所有追求者，并温柔地解释说她还太年轻不能结婚，宁愿留在她亲爱的父亲身边。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, a terrible stroke of misfortune befell the merchant. A fleet of his merchant ships carrying valuable cargo was destroyed at sea by violent storms, and his warehouse in the city burned to the ground overnight. Overnight, the wealthy merchant lost his entire fortune, leaving him with nothing except a small, neglected cottage deep in the countryside, miles away from the city.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，一场可怕的不幸降临到了商人身上。他船队中载有昂贵货物的一组商船在海上被猛烈的暴风雪毁灭，而他在城里的仓库在一夜之间烧成了废墟。一夜之间，这位富商失去了全部财产，只留下一栋远离城市的、位于乡下深处的一栋失修的小农舍。

paragraphs.en: With tears streaming down his cheeks, the father gathered his children and announced that they must move to the small farm and work with their hands for their daily bread. The two eldest daughters wept furiously, declaring they would never leave the city, expecting their wealthy suitors to rescue them. But to their horror, their suitors vanished the moment they heard of the bankruptcy. Beauty, though deeply saddened by her father's grief, remained cheerful and brave, resolving to embrace their new humble life with hard work and gratitude.
paragraphs.zh: 眼泪沿着面颊流下，父亲召集了他的孩子们，宣布他们必须搬到那个小农场，用双手劳动来换取每日的面包。两个大姐姐愤怒地大哭，声称她们绝不离开城市，期望她们有钱的追求者来拯救她们。但令她们恐怖的是，追求者们一听到破产的消息就销声匿迹了。贝儿虽然为父亲的悲伤感到十分难过，却依然保持着乐观与勇敢，决心用勤劳和感恩去拥抱他们卑微的新生活。

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Journey to the Port and the Snowstorm
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：港口之旅与迷失暴风雪

paragraphs.en: For a year, the family lived quietly in the rustic cottage. Beauty woke at four o'clock every morning to light the fires, clean the house, and prepare meals for her family, while her brothers plowed the fields. One morning, a letter arrived informing the father that one of his lost trading ships had safely docked at the harbor. Overjoyed by the prospect of regaining his wealth, the merchant prepared to ride to the distant port.
paragraphs.zh: 一整年来，一家人在朴素的农舍里平静地生活着。贝儿每天早上四点起床点火、打扫房子、为家人准备饭菜，而她的哥哥们则在田里耕作。一天清晨，一封信送达，告知父亲他失踪的一艘商船已安全靠港。因有望重获财富而喜出望外，商人准备骑马前往远方的港口。

paragraphs.en: Before he set out, the two eldest daughters greedily begged him to bring back rich velvet gowns, golden jewelry, and rare silk scarves. 'And what shall I bring for you, Beauty?' asked the father warmly. Beauty wished for nothing, but seeing her father's insistence, she replied softly, 'I only ask for a fresh rose, dear father, for none grow in our cold countryside garden.'
paragraphs.zh: 在他出发前，两个大姐姐贪婪地恳求他带回华丽的天鹅绒长袍、黄金珠宝和罕见的丝绸围巾。“那我为你带点什么呢，贝儿？”父亲温和地问。贝儿什么都不想要，但看到父亲的坚持，她软软地回答：“我只想要一朵新鲜的玫瑰，亲爱的父亲，因为我们冷清的乡村花园里一朵也没长。”

paragraphs.en: When the merchant reached the port, he suffered a bitter disappointment. A lawsuit was brought against his cargo, and after paying heavy legal fees, he was forced to turn back empty-handed, as poor as when he left. As he rode home through a dense forest, a sudden violent snowstorm blew up. The icy wind howled, blinding his horse with deep snow, and the dark forest echoed with the terrifying howls of hungry wolves.
paragraphs.zh: 当商人到达港口时，他遭受了沉重的打击。一场诉讼针对他的货物展开，在支付了高昂的法律费用后，他不得不空手而归，像来时一样贫穷。当他骑马穿过密林回家时，一场突如其来的猛烈暴风雪刮了起来。冰冷的风咆哮着，深雪迷盲了他的马，黑暗的森林里回荡着饥饿狼群的可怕咆哮。

chapters.title: Chapter 4: The Enchanted Palace and the Rose
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：神秘城堡与红玫瑰惩罚

paragraphs.en: Fearing for his life, the frozen merchant spotted a dim light shining through the trees. Following the glow, he arrived at a magnificent palace surrounded by enchanted gardens. Strange to say, the massive iron gates stood wide open, and no guards were anywhere to be seen. Entering the great marble hall, he found a warm fire blazing in the hearth and a lavish feast laid out on a golden table, complete with fine wines.
paragraphs.zh: 为生命担忧的冻僵商人发现树林深处透着一缕微弱的光亮。沿着光芒走去，他来到了一座被魔法花园环绕的雄伟城堡。说来奇怪，巨大的铁门敞开着，到处看不到任何卫兵。进入大理石大厅，他发现火炉里燃烧着温暖的火焰，黄金桌子上摆好了丰盛的盛宴，还配有美酒。

paragraphs.en: After waiting in vain for the master of the house, the exhausted merchant ate the delicious food and fell asleep in a soft velvet bed. The next morning, renewed and refreshed, he walked into the palace garden. Noticing a bower blooming with exquisite red roses, he remembered Beauty's wish and snapped a branch bearing several blossoms. Instantly, a deafening roar echoed through the garden, and a terrifying, hideous Beast bounded out before him, its eyes flashing with fury!
paragraphs.zh: 在徒劳地等待主人出现后，疲惫不堪的商人吃了美味的食物，并在软棉的天鹅绒床上睡着了。第二天早上，焕发活力的他走进了城堡花园。注意到一座开满精致红玫瑰的凉亭，想起贝儿的愿望，他折下了一枝带着几朵花朵的树枝。瞬间，一声 deafening 咆哮声在花园里回荡，一只可怕、丑陋的野兽跳到了他面前，它的双眼闪烁着怒火！

paragraphs.en: 'Ungrateful man!' roared the Beast in a fierce, thunderous voice. 'I saved your life by welcoming you into my magic palace, and in return, you steal my prized roses, which I value more than my own life! For this insult, you must die!' The terrified merchant dropped to his knees, begging for mercy and explaining that the rose was a gift for his daughter. The Beast paused, his fiery eyes softening slightly: 'I will grant you mercy on one condition—one of your daughters must come willingly to suffer death in your place within three months, or you must return to meet your fate!'
paragraphs.zh: “忘恩负义的人！”野兽用凶猛雷鸣般的声音咆哮道。“我欢迎你来到我的魔法城堡救了你的命，而作为回报，你偷了我珍视的玫瑰，那是比我自己的生命还要宝贵的东西！为了这种侮辱，你必须死！”惊恐万状的商人跪在地上求情，解释说玫瑰是给女儿的礼物。野兽停顿了一下，炙热的双眼稍微放缓：“我可以满足你的慈悲，但有一个条件——你的一个女儿必须自愿在三个月内来代替你受死，否则你必须回来接受你的命运！”

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Beauty’s Sacrifice and Departure
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：贝儿的牺牲与离别时刻

paragraphs.en: The heart-broken merchant arrived home in tears and presented the fateful rose to Beauty, telling his weeping children of the terrifying bargain he had made with the Beast. Upon hearing the tale, the two eldest sisters turned upon Beauty with vicious hatred: 'Look at what your foolish rose has cost our father!' they shrieked. 'You ought to die for your silly vanity, but you will let our father perish while you stay safe at home!'
paragraphs.zh: 心碎的商人含泪回到家，将那朵决定命运的玫瑰递给贝儿，向哭泣的孩子们讲述了他与野兽作出的可怕交易。一听到这个故事，两个大姐姐带着恶毒的仇恨冲着贝儿咆哮：“看看你愚蠢的玫瑰给我们父亲带来了什么代价！”她们尖叫道。“你本该为了你傻乎乎的虚荣去死，但你却要让我们父亲丧命，而你安全地待在家里！”

paragraphs.en: Beauty remained perfectly calm, wiping her tear-stained face with dignity. 'No,' she said resolutely. 'My father shall not suffer for my sake. Since the Beast will accept a daughter, I shall gladly go in his place, and no power on earth will alter my decision.' Despite her father's desperate weeping and her brothers' offers to fight the Beast, Beauty stood firm, preparing for her journey.
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿保持着绝对的平静，带着尊严擦干沾满泪水的脸庞。“不，”她坚定地说。“我的父亲不能为了我受苦。既然野兽会接受一个女儿，我将欣然代替他前去，世上没有任何力量能改变我的决定。”尽管她父亲绝望地哭泣，哥哥们提出去与野兽决斗，贝儿依然立场坚定，为旅程做准备。

paragraphs.en: When the three months expired, Beauty and her father rode back to the enchanted palace. The grand hall was lit with candles, and a sumptuous feast for two was prepared. As they dined in heavy silence, the heavy footfalls of the Beast echoed through the corridor. The hideous creature entered, his terrible form making Beauty shudder, though she forced herself to stand tall.
paragraphs.zh: 当三个月到期时，贝儿和她的父亲骑马回到了魔法城堡。大厅里点亮了蜡烛，为两个人准备了丰盛的盛宴。当他们在沉重的寂静中用餐时，野兽沉重的脚步声在走廊里回荡。这个丑陋的生物进来了，他可怕的外形让贝儿瑟瑟发抖，尽管她强迫自己挺直身姿。

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Life in the Castle and the Beast’s Kindness
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 6 章：城堡生活与野兽的体贴

paragraphs.en: 'Have you come here of your own free will?' asked the Beast in a low, rumbling voice. 'Yes,' whispered Beauty, her voice trembling slightly. 'You are noble and good,' said the Beast softly. 'Old man, tomorrow morning you shall depart for home, and you must never set foot in this palace again.' Turning to Beauty, he added gently, 'Good night, Beauty.' 'Good night, Beast,' she replied quietly.
paragraphs.zh: “你是出自你自己的自由意志来到这里的吗？”野兽用低沉轰鸣的声音问。“是的，”贝儿低语道，声音稍微发颤。“你高尚而善良，”野兽软软地说。“老人家，明天早上你必须启程回家，再也不许踏入这座城堡一步。”转向贝儿，他温柔地补充道：“晚安，贝儿。”“晚安，野兽，”她平静地回答。

paragraphs.en: Beauty expected to be devoured during the night, but when she woke the next morning, she was astonished to find herself in a luxurious chamber fit for a queen. Attached to her bedroom was a vast library containing thousands of illuminated books, a music room with rare harps, and magical mirrors that allowed her to view any part of the world at will. Above her door, golden letters read: 'Welcome, Princess; your every wish is our command.'
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿预料夜晚会被吞噬，但当她第二天早上醒来时，她惊讶地发现自己身处于一个适合王后居住的奢华房间里。紧挨着她卧室的是一座巨大的图书馆，藏有成千上万本精美的图书，一个配备有罕见竖琴的音乐室，以及允许她随意观看世界任何角落的魔法镜子。在她门上方，黄金字写着：“欢迎，公主；您的一切愿望都是我们的指令。”

paragraphs.en: Every evening at nine o'clock, the Beast joined Beauty for dinner. Instead of a savage monster, Beauty discovered that the Beast spoke with profound wisdom, rich humor, and boundless gentle courtesy. Though his terrifying appearance initially frightened her, she grew accustomed to his ugliness and looked forward to their evening chats. Yet before leaving each night, the Beast would look into her eyes and ask timidly, 'Beauty, will you marry me?' And each night, Beauty would softly reply, 'No, Beast, but I am your sincere friend.'
paragraphs.zh: 每天晚上九点钟，野兽都会与贝儿共进晚餐。贝儿没有发现野羊般野蛮的怪物，而是发现野兽的谈吐充满了深刻的智慧、丰富的幽默与无尽的温柔礼貌。尽管他可怕的外表最初吓到了她，但她逐渐习惯了他的丑陋，并期待着他们的晚间交谈。然而在每天晚上离开前，野兽都会看着她的眼睛怯生生地问：“贝儿，你愿意嫁给我吗？”而每天晚上，贝儿都会软软地回答：“不，野兽，但我也是你真诚的朋友。”

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Magic Mirror and the Return Home
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 7 章：魔法镜子与重返家园

paragraphs.en: Several months passed happily in the enchanted castle. Beauty spent her peaceful days reading rare romantic poetry, playing beautiful melodies on the harpsichord, and wandering through the fragrant glass greenhouses filled with rare tropical flowers. She lacked for nothing, and her fondness for the kind Beast grew deeper with each passing day as she realized his extraordinary goodness of heart.
paragraphs.zh: 几个月在魔法城堡里快乐地过去了。贝儿在安静的日子里阅读罕见的浪漫诗歌，在大键琴上弹奏美丽的旋律，漫步于开满罕见热带花卉的香气扑鼻的玻璃温室中。她什么也不缺，随着时间的流逝，当她意识到野兽非凡的心灵美德时，她对这位和蔼野兽的喜欢一天天加深。

paragraphs.en: Yet despite all her comforts, Beauty missed her beloved father dearly. One afternoon, looking into her magical mirror, she saw a heartbreaking scene: her poor father was lying bedridden in their small farm cottage, weeping bitterly and sick with grief over her unknown fate, while her sisters were preparing for luxurious parties.
paragraphs.zh: 然而尽管享受着所有的舒适，贝儿非常思念她亲爱的父亲。一天下午，看着她的魔法镜子，她看到了一幕令人心碎的场景：她可怜的父亲正因她未知的命运而悲伤号啕大哭、卧病在床，而她的姐姐们正在为奢华的聚会做准备。

paragraphs.en: Tears streamed down Beauty's face. That evening at dinner, when the Beast entered, he noticed her red eyes and asked with deep concern, 'What grieves you, dear Beauty?' Beauty threw herself at his feet, pleading with clasped hands: 'Oh, kind Beast! My poor father is dying of sorrow for me! If you love me, please allow me to return home to visit him for just seven days! I promise upon my sacred honor to return to you when the week is over!' The Beast consented with a heavy sigh, giving her a magic ring.
paragraphs.zh: 眼泪沿着贝儿的脸流下。那天晚上晚餐时，当野兽进来时，他注意到了她红红的双眼，怀着深深的关切问：“什么让你伤心，亲爱的贝儿？”贝儿扑倒在他的脚下，紧扣着双手恳求道：“哦，和蔼的野兽！我可怜的父亲正因思念我而悲伤得要死了！如果你爱我，请允许我回家看望他仅仅七天！我以我神圣的荣誉承诺在这一周结束后回到你身边！”野兽带着沉重的叹息同意了，给了她一只魔法戒指。

chapters.title: Chapter 8: True Love and the Prince Awakened
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 8 章：真爱解除诅咒与王子重现（终极幸福）

paragraphs.en: Beauty awoke the next morning in her father's cottage. When her father entered the room and found his daughter healthy, radiant, and richly attired, he wept with overwhelming joy, embracing her again and again. Beauty showed him a magic trunk that had arrived with her, filled with precious jewels and gold coins sent by the generous Beast to restore her father's fortune.
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿第二天早上在父亲的农舍里醒来。当她父亲进入房间发现他的女儿健康、容光焕发且穿着华丽时，他流下了无尽喜悦的眼泪，一次又一次地拥抱她。贝儿向他展示了一个随她一起到达的魔法箱，里面装满了慷慨野兽寄来的宝贵珠宝与金币，用以恢复她父亲的财富。

paragraphs.en: Her two jealous sisters, burning with envy, plotted to keep her beyond the seven days so the Beast would devour her in anger. Touched by their fake tears, Beauty stayed longer. But on the tenth night, she dreamed she saw the Beast lying unconscious near the rose bower, dying of grief! Horror struck her heart: 'How cruel I am to hurt the one who has shown me boundless devotion!'
paragraphs.zh: 她的两个嫉妒的姐姐因嫉妒而发狂，策划把她留到七天以上，以便野兽在愤怒中吞噬她。被她们假的眼泪所打动，贝儿多留了几天。但在第十天晚上，她梦见野兽昏迷地躺在玫瑰凉亭附近，因悲伤而濒死！恐怖击中了她的心灵：“我是多么残酷去伤害一个对我展现无尽奉献的人！”

paragraphs.en: Beauty immediately placed the gold magic ring on her table and fell asleep. Waking back in the magic castle, she ran into the garden and found the Beast motionless near the rose bower. Throwing herself upon him, she wept bitterly: 'Oh Beast, live! Live to be my husband! I love you with all my soul!' The air blazed with radiant light and music! The Beast vanished, and in his place stood a handsome Prince, who thanked her for breaking the spell. They were married in triumph, living happily ever after.
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿立刻将金色的魔法戒指放在她的桌子上睡着了。在魔法城堡醒来，她跑进花园发现野兽倒在玫瑰凉亭附近动也不动。扑倒在他身上，她号啕大哭：“哦野兽，活下来！活下来做我的妻子吧！我全心全意爱着你！”空气中放出了绚丽的光芒与音乐！野兽消失了，取而代之的是一位英俊的王子，感谢她打破了咒语。他们在胜利中结婚了，从此幸福地生活在一起。
